info: An "If–then" plan means thinking about a hard moment in advance and deciding now what you'll do. Research shows these plans make it easier to turn an intention into action. Some situations can't be avoided, so a plan can also be "I'll do this while the urge is there".

waking.if: When I wake up in the morning
then: I'll drink a glass of water first and take a shower
instead of a cigarette I'll open the window and take five deep breaths
I'll notice the urge and have breakfast in another room

coffee_tea.if: When I'm having my coffee or tea
then: I'll sit somewhere different from usual
I'll hold a pen or a stress ball to keep my hand busy
I'll notice the urge and focus on my sips
I'll get up straight away and brush my teeth
I'll leave the table and walk for five minutes
I'll keep my hands busy by washing the dishes

work_break.if: When I take a break at work
then: I'll walk in a different direction, not to the smoking area
I'll call someone for a chat during my break
I'll grab my water bottle and do a short stretch

stress.if: When I feel stressed or angry
then: I'll breathe slowly and watch the urge pass
I'll breathe in for four seconds and out for six
I'll wait ten minutes and write down what I feel
I'll put on a song I like and go for a short walk
I'll start a small task I can do with my hands
I'll message someone
I'll hold my glass in the hand I'd hold a cigarette with
I'll keep away from the smokers
I'll go over my plan before I arrive
I'll say "Thanks, I've quit"
I'll have something to drink and keep chatting
I'll notice the urge and remind myself of my reasons

driving.if: When I get a craving while driving
then: I'll chew gum
I'll put on a podcast I like
I'll open the window and take a deep breath

phone.if: When I'm talking on the phone
then: I'll hold a pen in my free hand
I'll walk while I talk
I'll move somewhere inside, not to the balcony
I'll drink a warm herbal tea
I'll do a short breathing exercise
I'll brush my teeth early

toilet.if: When I get a craving in the toilet
then: I'll open a short game on my phone
I'll spend less time there
I'll notice the urge and focus on my breath for a minute
